agent_explanation: Energy gain at high-speed wall collision with high restitution. Body 0 approaches thin vertical wall (x=10.6, w=0.1) at ~38.89 m/s (step 6, vx +38.887). After collision at step 7 vx is reversed to -41.33 and speed increases to 41.34, so kinetic energy exceeds incoming energy despite e=0.912<1 and no controller work. Allowed = 900.41 (E0 814.01) but recorded 911.94. Counterfactual with same scenario but e=0 shows inelastic collision correctly dissipates energy and passes, proving violation is caused by restitution/collision impulse logic adding energy (e.g., incorrect impulse magnitude, double correction, or substep integration error on fast body hitting thin wall).
